opportunities.action: Ask what changed in 2026 size, currency and tenor preference; test DCM, bilateral and FX/CCS appetite.

meeting_questions: What has changed in KDB's 2026 offshore funding plan versus 2025 — size, tenor or currency mix?

Which ASEAN countries or sectors are taking the most attention from Korean corporate clients this year?
